body:
Looks like it should solve the problem. We should really have caught that during review. Thanks for fixing!

> It seems like it also might be worth changing this check in _release_unique_name_in_owner() to use ERR_FAIL_COND() rather than just silently ignoring it

That might be true, but it has some risk of regression, so a pull request making this change should target 4.6.
